title: Spire and Salt Revisited
author: Theo Okafor
blurb: August Dravenmoor, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
